name: @gami/web
note: wagmi/@base-org/account/@privy-io/react-auth are listed here only so Next's bundler/type resolution can reach them through @gami/identity's peer deps — app code must never `import` them directly (eslint rule 1 blocks it; use @gami/identity's GamiWalletProvider/GamiPrivyWebProvider and the GamiWallet/useGamiSiweLogin seam instead). Explicitly forbidden here (§14, enforced by eslint rule 5): @farcaster/*, @coinbase/onchainkit/minikit — @privy-io/react-auth declares @farcaster/mini-app-solana as an OPTIONAL peer only, confirmed not installed (pnpm doesn't resolve optional peers unless something else needs them), so it doesn't trip the gate:no-farcaster-deps check.
